headword: {文民統制|ぶんみんとうせい}

definitions.gloss: civilian control of the military; civil supremacy over the armed forces
definitions.explanation: The principle that elected civilian leaders, not military officers, have ultimate authority over military decisions and policy. A cornerstone of democratic governance.

examples.japanese: {文民統制|ぶんみんとうせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{基本原則|きほんげんそく}だ。
examples.english: Civilian control of the military is a fundamental principle of democracy.

examples.japanese: {防衛大臣|ぼうえいだいじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文民統制|ぶんみんとうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{象徴|しょうちょう}→象徴：05534_shouchou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{文民|ぶんみん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Minister of Defense is appointed from among civilians as a symbol of civilian control.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦前|せんぜん}→戦前：12852_senzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反省|はんせい}→反省：03570_hansei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文民統制|ぶんみんとうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原則|げんそく}→原則：11801_gensoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{定|さだ}められた→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: Reflecting on prewar experience, the postwar Japanese constitution clearly established the principle of civilian control.

notes:
Composed of {文民|ぶんみん} (civilian) and ⟦{統制|とうせい}→統制：21836_tousei⟧ (control, regulation). Also known by the English loanword シビリアン⟦コントロール→コントロール：10861_kontorooru⟧. A key concept in Japanese political discourse given the country's wartime history.

USAGE:
Frequently appears in discussions of defense policy, constitutional law, and Japanese history. The concept gained special importance in postwar Japan after the ⟦{軍部|ぐんぶ}→軍部：24654_gunbu⟧ (military establishment) effectively controlled government policy in the 1930s-40s. Article 66 of the Japanese Constitution requires that the Prime Minister and all cabinet ministers be civilians.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文民統制|ぶんみんとうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原則|げんそく}→原則：11801_gensoku⟧: the principle of civilian control
- {文民統制|ぶんみんとうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ensure civilian control
- {文民統制|ぶんみんとうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: civilian control functions properly
- {文民統制|ぶんみんとうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逸脱|いつだつ}→逸脱：07525_itsudatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deviate from civilian control

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シビリアン⟦コントロール→コントロール：10861_kontorooru⟧: civilian control (English loanword) — the same concept expressed as a loanword; used interchangeably in Japanese
- {統帥権|とうすいけん}: supreme command authority — the prewar concept of the emperor's direct command over the military, which circumvented civilian oversight
- ⟦{軍部|ぐんぶ}→軍部：24654_gunbu⟧: military establishment — the institutional force that civilian control is designed to check
